name: Power Apps CLI (pa)
description: Installs the Microsoft Power Apps CLI (pa, npm @microsoft/power-apps-cli). Needs Node.js 22 or newer and a Secret Service keyring, which the keyring Feature provides. With version 'latest' it follows the latest release (`agentbox prerequisite update` keeps it current).

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes the Power Apps CLI (`pa`), which is pre-installed and available on the `PATH`. Run `pa --help` for the command reference and `pa auth status` to check the signed-in account.
